_comment: Trimmed/hand-assembled from a real https://json.edhrec.com/pages/tags/tokens.json response captured 2026-07-16 -- kept only the 'topcommanders' cardlist (the actual archetype-relevant one; the page also has newcards/topcards/creatures/etc lists of non-commander cards which our by-name matching safely ignores) and swapped in a couple of commander names that also appear in sample_color_page.json so test_db.py can exercise the color+theme merge. Field names/shapes (id, name, sanitized, slug, url, num_decks, potential_decks) are the real ones EDHREC uses -- note the url pattern here is /commanders/<slug>/tokens (theme-qualified), unlike the plain /commanders/<slug> on color pages.
